decisions.title: Visual canon approval
decisions.observation: No explicit approval of these visual designs was found in the reviewed source records. Entity existence and a public visual target are insufficient.
decisions.next_action: Owner: approve, retain candidate, classify exploratory, or explicitly supersede each visual variant. Record exact concept ID, source hash and decision date.

decisions.title: Production provenance and rights
decisions.observation: CONCEPT-001..003 retain prompts/service but not the account-plan evidence; CONCEPT-004/005 explicitly lack service, prompt, inputs and terms. Later generation/specification rows do not establish complete production-use rights.
decisions.next_action: Owner/provenance custodian: complete intended-use records in the existing AssetRegister before production use. Preserve source credits and source files.

decisions.title: Reference completeness and production scope
decisions.observation: No complete per-object orthographic/dimension/socket/budget package was discovered for this thread. All production IDs are unallocated and maturity remains NOT_STARTED.
decisions.next_action: Future production owner: authorize a bounded asset package, resolve shape/scale, and prepare reviewed references using the pipeline specification.

decisions.title: Building dimensions conflict
decisions.observation: ComponentDesignCatalog gives Anchor 6x6, Foundry 8x6, Memory Hearth 7x7 and very large Kharuun heights; current source/master detail retains Anchor/Hearth 5x5 and production buildings 4x4. Other structure footprints also differ.
decisions.next_action: Owner/design authority: resolve the dimensional brief; do not bake image or catalog dimensions into models. Registry stores observed gameplay footprints separately from TBD production dimensions.

decisions.title: Unit silhouette and roster conflicts
decisions.observation: The original Surveyor/Lancer/Bulwark sheet depicts biped/operator/platform forms. ComponentDesignCatalog describes tracked Surveyor, wheeled Lancer, tank Bulwark and names Atlas Mech, Shardbearer and alternate Choir units. Those labels are not the established source roster.
decisions.next_action: Owner: choose approved form for each existing entity; treat unsupported designs as candidates, not roster additions or authorization to alter gameplay.

decisions.title: Future Well variants and state continuity
decisions.observation: The four-state sheet, composed-target rings and celestial spiral are different studies. The hero landscape central light is unidentified and is not assigned to the Well family.
decisions.next_action: Owner: select common geometry/state grammar and explicit variant relationships. Preserve all alternatives. Review collapse/temporary-crossing transitions against the current Well contract.

decisions.title: Geographic and mission interpretation
decisions.observation: Map/landscape concepts and website radar contain geographic names, mission labels, routes and structures. These are not authoritative passability, current map topology or proof of the depicted historical event.
decisions.next_action: Owner/map designer: bind each approved environment element to current mission/canon source and retain uncertain scene details without inventing geography. Lume Reach has map-symbol coverage, not a dedicated detailed environment image.

decisions.title: UI labels, identity and numeric conflicts
decisions.observation: Traditional UI sheets are comparative studies. Concept images contain unsupported labels such as Atlas Mech and Lyra, and a -24 LKFS calibration display. Catalog UI requirement pointers do not consistently match the master: SPEC-UI-002 is Selection fields, SPEC-UI-006 is Remapping; do not adopt caption IDs as acceptance.
decisions.next_action: Owner/UI designer: choose original UI direction, reconcile labels/metrics against current requirements, and identify or reject unnamed portrait/unit portrayals. No franchise layout or unsupported ability is adopted.

decisions.title: VFX capability versus visual grammar
decisions.observation: Weapon/shield/phase illustrations suggest effects, not additional authoritative powers, collision, damage or world-state changes. The catalog SPEC-VFX-001 caption does not establish a current master binding.
decisions.next_action: Future VFX owner: bind each accepted effect to an existing event and state, identify sockets/timing/accessibility variants, and measure cost under current visual requirements.
decisions.evidence: Docs/ArtDirection.md Effects grammar; Docs/Requirements.md SPEC-VISD-007 and SPEC-ART-002

decisions.title: Missing dedicated character and Choir unit images
decisions.observation: CONCEPT-025 contains five character design specifications and crests; CONCEPT-026 contains four Choir unit specifications. Neither is a retained raster sheet. Mara has a bridge-menu portrayal; crests do not supply anatomy or modeling views.
decisions.next_action: Owner: approve future missing-art/reference work when the plan permits. Do not generate replacements for existing concepts.

decisions.title: Existing production asset crosswalk
decisions.observation: 145 tracked Content/Art .uasset paths have existing AssetRegister provenance but no newly allocated production IDs in this thread. Ten public capture originals are linked only as comparison evidence.
decisions.next_action: Future integration owner: reconcile existing registry entries and source/generator paths to approved concept and production IDs without renaming or regenerating current assets.

decisions.title: Remaining evidence boundaries
decisions.observation: 876 local development captures are enumerated and hashed, not individually visually requalified. Engine caches/dependencies, directory symlink targets, unavailable remote branches and non-repository personal art stores are outside the scan.
decisions.next_action: If broader archival review is needed, authorize and scope that specific source set. Never use these capture counts as proof of runtime or art acceptance.

decisions.title: Placeholder versus intended final design
decisions.observation: Owner clarified that some existing images are placeholders awaiting better concepts. Internal review identifies per-image replacement/rework candidates in visual-use-assessment.json.
decisions.next_action: Before later production, select retained designs and prioritize replacement concepts explicitly; preserve old source history. No current image is implicitly chosen for use.
